However, EBITDA fell 24.4% YoY as margin slipped to 7.1% (9.7% in Q2FY26; our estimate 9.5%), on higher material and other expenses.

Management has cut FY27 standalone revenue growth guidance for the second time, to ~5–10% (10–15% after Q1, 20% at the start of the year), and expects margin to improve by ~150bps by year-end, to ~9–9.5% in H2.
Order book stands at INR 159.6bn (~2.7x TTM standalone revenue, +7% YoY) after INR 19.7bn of inflows in Q2; including INR 3.9bn won after September and INR 8.7bn where ASBL is L1, it is INR 172.2bn.
